description: The largest loan the partner vaults fund now for at most maxCollateral of a token, at the lowest fixed cost they accept; or one exact loan (collateral and principal) at the lowest cost that funds it now, or at your own costBps, with what each Loan grade costs; in USDG or the lend asset named, with a prepare object for gage_prepare_borrow.

collateral.description: With principal: the exact pledge of one chosen loan, raw units

costBps.description: With collateral and principal: your own fixed cost for the loan instead, bps of the amount borrowed, to a tenth (more digits are rounded); the quote's grades say what each Loan grade costs

lendAsset.description: The asset the loan is paid in and repaid in: USDG when omitted, or a lend asset gage_capabilities lists (its token address)

maxCollateral.description: Most of the token to pledge, raw units: quotes the largest loan the vaults fund for it, at the lowest fixed cost they accept

principal.description: With collateral: the exact amount to borrow, raw units of the loan's asset; priced at the lowest fixed cost the vaults funding it accept, or at costBps

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of the terms gage_capabilities lists

name: gage_borrow_quote
title: Borrow quote
